name: dsh-github-gate
description: Guarded GitHub tools for DeepSeek Harness: 9 typed github_* tools (58 actions) over the GitHub CLI, where every state-changing action goes through a confirm gate plus a human approval seam, with a digest-verified self-update. | 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 GitHub 工具：9 个 github_* 工具，所有改状态动作都必须经过 confirm 与人工审批门，并支持摘要校验的自更新。

scripts.test: node tools/ensure-vendor.mjs && node --import ./test/register-hook.mjs --test test/offline.test.mjs test/r3.test.mjs test/update.test.mjs test/settings.test.mjs test/client.test.mjs test/plugin.test.mjs
scripts.probe: node tools/ensure-vendor.mjs && node tools/probe-schemastery.mjs && node --import ./test/register-hook.mjs tools/probe-define-tool.mjs
scripts.verify:offline: node tools/ensure-vendor.mjs && node tools/probe-schemastery.mjs && node --import ./test/register-hook.mjs tools/probe-define-tool.mjs && node --import ./test/register-hook.mjs tools/verify-bundle.mjs && node --import ./test/register-hook.mjs tools/verify-params.mjs && node --import ./test/register-hook.mjs tools/probe-guidance.mjs && node tools/knowledge-index.mjs && node tools/recurrence-report.mjs && node --import ./test/register-hook.mjs --test test/offline.test.mjs test/r3.test.mjs test/update.test.mjs test/settings.test.mjs test/client.test.mjs test/plugin.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run verify:offline && node --import ./test/register-hook.mjs test/live-readonly.mjs && node --import ./test/register-hook.mjs tools/probe-connectivity.mjs
scripts.release: npm run verify && npm run encoding && npm run report:check -- --strict && npm run profile:check && npm run probe:argv && npm run probe:arity && node tools/compare-installed.mjs
